public_rationale: The evidence points in different directions for different measures. ChatGPT Pro was reportedly losing money in its early operation, while OpenAI's broader paid-user compute margin was reportedly positive at the end of 2024. One plan cannot establish the broad assertion, and compute margin does not measure profit after all corporate costs. Because the claim leaves its accounting basis unspecified, neither report can settle it under the money-claim rules.
limitations: Historical compute-margin figures are available through secondary reporting, not released underlying accounts.
The Pro statement concerns a narrower product and does not isolate Q4.
Different products can have different margins within an unprofitable company.
